how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will fetch the minimum tick size of an instrument and return a number for the same. Tick size can be used in combination with other keywords to make comprehensive formulae to achieve a specific mathematical operation. Its specially useful when using lists with multiple instruments.

![Example](./images/img-1631867087.png)

The keyword shared above will find the minimum tick size for all the instruments within the Nifty 50 stocks list as prescribed by the exchange.
